issue.title: Property Card Cabinets
issue.description: Child areas, sub-projects, notebooks, albums, and album records open as collapsible cabinets at the bottom of their note's Property Card. Each cabinet shows exactly the data its H2 section showed. Album Schema and bank Setup move into the same chrome as a restyled Properties cabinet, and `_` becomes a numbered, cancel-safe cabinet pick. The stored catalogs stay bob-owned Markdown, and nothing in bob-cli, the release train, or Bob Mac Capture changes. The work lands dark beside bob-cli-qj, bob-cli-qm, and bob-cli-qp and switches on only after the sibling go-lives it would race.

issue.title: The `_` dispatch and numbered cabinet pick
issue.description: keys: route `_` to the details fold (zero extras), a direct toggle (one), or an armed pick (two or more). The pick uses a Scope plus a capture listener, and snapshots semantic kinds. It lights the on-card digits and the footer overlay. `__` toggles 1 and `-` toggles Properties; Esc, `q`, and Ctrl+[ cancel. Disarm triggers and palette parity are included.
